verdict.rationale: The docs cover the restore half of the story. You can create a Postgres branch restored to a point-in-time timestamp with --restore-point, and backups (daily scheduled plus manual) can be restored for both production and development branches, so no dump rebuild is needed. Nothing shows resetting a branch from its parent, and restores appear to produce a new branch rather than rewinding the existing one in place. missing for 10: reset/refresh-from-parent capability, in-place branch restore, detailed restore workflow docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
